

```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(cohortED)

```

```{r}
# Unpack parameters
content_area   <- params$content_area
target_grade   <- params$target_grade
years          <- params$years
dataset_path   <- params$dataset

# Convert years to numeric values
years_num      <- parse_year(years)

# Derived variables
subject_label  <- toupper(content_area)
grade_label    <- paste("Grade", target_grade)
previous_grade <- target_grade - 1
first_year     <- min(years_num)
current_year   <- max(years_num)
previous_year  <- max(years_num) - 1

```

```{r}
# Load in the dataset
if (!file.exists(params$dataset)) {
  stop(paste("Dataset file not found:", params$dataset))
} else {
  dataset <- readRDS(params$dataset)
}

```
